sourceProvenance.title: Meu Pintinho Amarelinho
sourceProvenance.edition: Independent Pianify notation of the traditional melody in C major; no Galinha Pintadinha recording, branding, sound or arrangement is used; Pianify editorial harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain traditional children's song; modern recordings and branded arrangements are excluded
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.
